A modern IPTV player. It loads the [iptv-org](https://github.com/iptv-org/iptv) public playlist and the [epgshare01](https://epgshare01.online/) TV guide by default.

## Downloads

| Platform | File |
| --- | --- |
| **Android** (phones, tablets, Android TV · Android 7.0+) | `LumenTV-<version>.apk` |

### Installing

- **Android**: download the APK on your device and open it. Allow "Install unknown apps" for your browser or file manager when asked.
  On Android TV, sideload it with a file manager or `adb install`.

## What's new in 1.9.7

- **A redesigned fullscreen channel browser** (the list button while watching fullscreen on phones and tablets).
  - **Two panes in landscape:**
    - A filter column: All channels, Favorites, Recently watched, Category and Country.
    - The channel list, with a compact search bar.
    - Many more channels fit on screen than before.
  - **Category and Country pickers** inside the panel, with channel counts and their own search. Back returns to the list.
  - **Channel numbers** on every row, plus **what's on next** and the **time left** for the current show.
  - **A star on every row** to add or remove favorites without leaving fullscreen.
  - **Previous channel** shortcut to jump back to what you were watching.
  - **Jump to what's playing:** a button appears when you've scrolled away from the channel you're watching.
  - The playing channel stands out with an accent bar and a soft gradient.
- **The mini player floats** over the page (from 1.9.6).
